name: Grok 5
short: Unreleased as of 2026-10-11 — not in SpaceXAI's API model list, pricing or release notes. Q1 and Q2 2026 windows both passed; Grok 4.5/4.6/4.7 shipped instead, and Musk has placed Grok 4.8 and 4.9 ahead of it with no date. Architecture, context, pricing and benchmarks are all unannounced.
contextWindow: Not announced (speculation ranges 128K to 2M; no vendor figure exists)
